text:
Ava: quick sync — I sketched a seatmap + cue script for the webinar tomorrow. want to lock speaker order and rehearsal blocks now.
Jon: posting link to the doc? need to confirm timezone for APAC backup attendees.
Ava: https://docs.redwood.ai/slides/webinar-seatmap (draft) — primary timezone PST, secondary UTC. APAC backup will be recorded + live Q&A in APAC-friendly window. :white_check_mark:
Priya: can we do a 30-min tech rehearsal 90 mins before start, + 10-min mic check 15 mins prior? last webinar benefited from the extra buffer.
Marco: +1 on the 30-min. also assigning "speaker wrangler" roles — @Kelsey will manage slides, @Neil will handle demo failover.
Kelsey: got it. I'll be on deck to advance slides and screen-share for the demo. can we make the slide deck immutable during the show (no accidental edits)?
Ava: yes — I'll export the final deck and put the vendor copy in the green-room folder, only Marco & Kelsey edit perms.
Sam: running order proposal:
1) Intro + housekeeping (Sam) — 2m
2) Product vision (Ava) — 5m
3) Benchmark narrative (Jon) — 8m
4) Demo: low-latency serving (Neil) — 8m
5) Customer case + Q&A (Kelsey + panel) — 20m
6) CTA & close (Sam) — 2m
Total ~45m + 10m buffer.
Jon: can we swap 3 & 4? showing demo before deep benchmarks helped retention in previous sessions.
Ava: open to swap — preference to give demo context before numbers. agree to 3 <-> 4 swap.
Marco: noted. speaker order updated. also mapping cues:
- Cue 1 (@Sam) "stage intro" — slide 1
- Cue 2 (@Ava) "vision" — slide 2
- Cue 3 (@Neil) "demo start" — run demo VM
- Cue 4 (@Kelsey) "customer story" — slide 12
- Cue 5 (@Sam) "Q&A open" — enable chat moderation
Neil: demo failover plan (short): if primary GPU pool overloaded, switch to quantized variant + disable streaming. command below to trigger fallback in staging console:
```
# fallback command
redwood route set --model rdx-gnl-quant --no-stream --reason "rehearsal fallback"
```
If we hit >150ms median, flip to the variant and call it out in voice.
Kelsey: can we script that switch as an ops button in green room? avoids manual CLI errors.
Neil: yes — I can add a single-click webhook. will test in the 30-min rehearsal.
Priya: rehearsal-bot scheduled two reminders: 90m and 15m before. @rehearsal-bot please ping the green-room Slack channel with final deck and stream keys.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder queued — will send messages to #marketing-green-room at T-90m and T-15m. :robot_face:
Ava: last items: final speaker bios (short) in the doc, 3 backup slides for network hiccups, and note in the cue script to call out the fallback briefly for transparency.
Jon: I'll prepare the benchmark one-pager to drop in chat during the demo — quick digest for folks who join late.
Sam: thanks all. final run-of-show PDF by me at T-60m, please review ASAP. :thumbsup:
Kelsey: ack, prepping mic check checklist.
Marco: assigning green-room roles in the doc now. any objections to moving the Q&A to the end-of-show only? last time cross-talk ate into demo time.
Ava: keep Q&A at end but take 1-2 live questions between segments if they're short; otherwise save for final panel.
Jon: cool — I'll moderate questions and triage to the panel.
Neil: testing the fallback button in staging at 14:00 PST. will post results here.
Ava: perfect — great work team. see you in green-room. :)
